say:0:1211010101:0.text: The water is shallow here. We'll be able to find some whitebelly bass.
say:0:1211010101:0.source_cn: 这里应该可以钓到白腹横纹鱼，试试。

say:0:1211010201:0.source_cn: 成功钓上第一只，很顺利嘛。

say:0:1211011001:0.text: Blasted gruglins! Let's drive them back!
say:0:1211011001:0.source_cn: 难缠的咕布林，赶走它们！

say:3:1211012002:0.text: It's the gruglin again! Magister, please stand back! Chippy will protect you.
say:3:1211012002:0.source_cn: 又是咕布林！主人，你们退后！满满来保护你们——
say:3:1211012002:0.male: It's the gruglin again! Magister, please stand back! Chippy will protect you.
say:3:1211012002:0.female: It's the gruglin again! Magister, please stand back! Chippy will protect you.

say:4:1211012003:1.text: Grug clah! People come to trial!

choice_prompt:5:1211012003.text: Grug clah! People come to trial!

say:7:1211012006:0.text: One at a time... on a plate... give to the daughter of the sea…
say:7:1211012006:0.source_cn: 一次一种，放在盘子里，献给海洋的女儿……！

say:9:1211012007:0.source_cn: 我的天，它还能说这么难的词？？？

say:11:1211012008:1.text: We've never met a gruglin that can talk normally before...
say:11:1211012008:1.source_cn: 不，那个，我们从来没遇到过能正常说话的咕布林……

say:12:1211012009:0.text: Scholars of the Evergreen Conservatory had to study for years to imitate their language so they could communicate with them.
say:12:1211012009:0.source_cn: 就连冬青学会的学者，都要学习和模仿很久才能理解它们想要...

choice_prompt:13:1211012009.text: Scholars of the Evergreen Conservatory had to study for years to imitate their language so they could communicate with them.
choice_prompt:13:1211012009.source_cn: 就连冬青学会的学者，都要学习和模仿很久才能理解它们想要传达的意思。

say:14:1211012010:0.text: This is amazing. Elusive locales, talking creatures, mysterious treasures... It's like an adventure out of a storybook!
say:14:1211012010:0.source_cn: 这多有意思，没见过的地方，会说话的当地生物，神秘的宝藏...
say:14:1211012010:0.male: This is amazing. Elusive locales, talking creatures, mysterious treasures... It's like an adventure out of a storybook!
say:14:1211012010:0.female: This is amazing. Elusive locales, talking creatures, mysterious treasures... It's like an adventure out of a storybook!

say:17:1211012012:0.text: This is too bizarre. I refuse to think about it.

say:19:1211012014:0.text: Ah, I remember! <style="stress">When the creatures of the sea return to the waters wide, the daughter of the ocean arises with pride.</style> That's the folk song.
say:19:1211012014:0.source_cn: 啊，我想起来了！<style=stress>当海中的生...

say:20:1211012015:1.text: Gruglin, do you want us to return the fish to the sea?
say:20:1211012015:1.source_cn: 咕布林，你想要让我们把海中的生灵，也就是鱼归海吗？

say:21:1211012016:0.text: Not the sea! On a plate... three kinds of fish! For the princess!
say:21:1211012016:0.source_cn: 不是归海！三种鱼……放盘子里！给公主！

say:22:1211012017:0.text: You mean the next trial is to find three types of fish... for a princess?
say:22:1211012017:0.source_cn: 意思是，下一道试炼是要找到三种鱼，放在某个盘子里？献给...

say:26:1211012019:1.text: A gruglin is actually helping us with the trial? This is unreal...
say:26:1211012019:1.source_cn: 咕布林居然会提醒我们钓鱼试炼的线索，简直像在做梦。

say:28:1211012020:1.text: This place is special. Chippy no longer finds anything strange here.
say:28:1211012020:1.source_cn: 这里无论发生什么，满满都不觉得奇怪了呢。

say:29:1211012021:1.text: Back to the point, I'm glad this guy pointed us in the right direction. We all know what we need to do now, right?
say:29:1211012021:1.source_cn: 回归正题。很高兴这哥们给我们指明了方向。大家都知道这个...

choice_prompt:30:1211012021.text: Back to the point, I'm glad this guy pointed us in the right direction. We all know what we need to do now, right?
choice_prompt:30:1211012021.source_cn: 回归正题。很高兴这哥们给我们指明了方向。大家都知道这个试炼要做什么了吧？

say:31:1211012022:1.text: That's right. There aren't many species of fish nearby. We need to find a good fishing spot.
say:31:1211012022:1.source_cn: 没错，附近的鱼类品种不算多，想寻找合适的钓点，是个技术活。
say:31:1211012022:1.male: That's right. There aren't many species of fish nearby. We need to find a good fishing spot.
say:31:1211012022:1.female: That's right. There aren't many species of fish nearby. We need to find a good fishing spot.

say:32:1211012023:1.text: Fortunately, Sonja and I both grew up in Rustport. As the saying goes...
say:32:1211012023:1.source_cn: 还好我和索尼娅都在锈锚港长大，有句话怎么说来着——

say:35:1211012024:1.text: "Rustport kids hook their first catch before they take their first step."
say:35:1211012024:1.source_cn: “锈锚港的孩子，还没学会走，就会在水里摸鱼了。”

say:36:1211012025:1.text: That's right. Come on, let me show you my skills.

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 钓三种鱼，放盘子里，给公主

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 这地方是不是不太对劲？

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 连路上的荧荧花都能说话

choice:13:2:3.text: I wonder if the rocks here can talk.
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 开始期待这里的石头开口
choice:13:2:3.male: I wonder if the rocks here can talk.
choice:13:2:3.female: I wonder if the rocks here can talk.

say:0:1211013001:0.text: We already have a whitebelly bass. We need two more types of fish.
say:0:1211013001:0.source_cn: 刚才我们已经钓上了白腹横纹鱼，还需要两种附近的鱼类。

say:1:1211013002:0.text: Follow me. I know where to find some blue groupers.
say:1:1211013002:0.source_cn: 接下来跟我走，我知道长吻蓝斑鱼在哪钓。

say:0:1211013101:0.text: This is it. Blue groupers like to hide in the shade.
say:0:1211013101:0.source_cn: 就是这，长吻蓝斑鱼喜欢躲在树阴里。

say:0:1211013201:0.text: Not bad. A blue grouper of that size is rare.
say:0:1211013201:0.source_cn: 不错，这么大的长吻蓝斑鱼很少见。

say:1:1211013202:0.text: We're still missing one more type of fish.
say:1:1211013202:0.source_cn: 还缺一种鱼，走，换个地方。

say:0:1211014001:0.text: The water is warmer over there. There should be some yellow shortfins in that spot.
say:0:1211014001:0.source_cn: 那边的水流比较温暖，应该会有黄鳍剪尾鱼。

say:0:1211014101:0.text: Yes, yellow shortfins can be found here.
say:0:1211014101:0.source_cn: 这里就是钓黄鳍剪尾鱼的地方。

say:1:1211015001:1.text: I'm exhausted... We finally caught three different kinds of fish.
say:1:1211015001:1.source_cn: 累死了……费了这么大劲，总算钓齐了三种鱼！

say:2:1211015002:1.text: It's already dark. Let's keep them in a little pond for now.
say:2:1211015002:1.source_cn: 天都黑了，先放在水洼里养着吧。

say:4:1211015003:1.text: Where should we bring them after this?
say:4:1211015003:1.source_cn: 接下来，我们要把这些鱼送去哪里？

say:5:1211015004:1.text: The gruglin said to give them to a princess. We can look around in the morning.
say:5:1211015004:1.source_cn: 那个智慧过人的咕布林说要送给公主，等天亮了再去找找吧。

say:7:1211015005:1.text: Oh, I've heard a story of a princess! A brave knight found her and woke her up from her dream.
say:7:1211015005:1.source_cn: 我听过公主的故事！勇敢的骑士找到了公主，把她从梦境里唤醒！

say:8:1211015006:1.text: Then the princess picked up a sword and defeated the dragon.
say:8:1211015006:1.source_cn: 然后——公主拿起刀，把恶龙打倒了！

say:10:1211015007:1.text: What kind of fairy tale is this? I've never heard of it...
say:10:1211015007:1.source_cn: 咦，这是什么童话故事？没听说过……

say:11:1211015008:1.text: It's a bedtime story that Sonja used to tell me.
say:11:1211015008:1.source_cn: 是索尼娅姐姐给我讲的睡前故事！

say:14:1211015010:1.text: I love listening to Sonja's stories! Whether it's the fairy eating the shark or the story of the lumberjack overthrowing a gang, I love them all!
say:14:1211015010:1.source_cn: 我很喜欢听索尼娅姐姐讲故事！无论是草仙子吃掉鲨鱼……还...

say:15:1211015011:1.text: Sonja, what types of stories did you tell your sister...? It seems there's more to you than meets the eye.
say:15:1211015011:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，你给你妹妹讲的都是些什么故事啊……嘿，你比我想...

say:16:1211015012:1.text: That was a long time ago... when I first joined the Carmine Whispers. Apparently, she remembers more than I do.
say:16:1211015012:1.source_cn: 那都是加入血薇帮很久以前的事了，我都记不清，她居然还记得。

say:17:1211015013:1.text: We have more important things to talk about... If we were to spend the night here, we're going to need a fire.
say:17:1211015013:1.source_cn: 不说这些了，如果要在这里过夜，我们得先把篝火燃起来。

say:2:1211016002:1.text: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.
say:2:1211016002:1.source_cn: 在我的人生中，几乎没有多少像这样，坐在海边，无所事事的...
say:2:1211016002:1.male: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.
say:2:1211016002:1.female: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.

choice_prompt:3:1211016002.text: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.
choice_prompt:3:1211016002.source_cn: 在我的人生中，几乎没有多少像这样，坐在海边，无所事事的悠闲时光了。
choice_prompt:3:1211016002.male: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.
choice_prompt:3:1211016002.female: I haven't had many moments like this in my life... Leisurely sitting by the sea, watching the waves with nothing to do.

say:4:1211016003:1.text: Yes, busy indeed. However, more than just being busy with work, it's hard for me not to worry about everything.
say:4:1211016003:1.source_cn: 忙……确实如此。但是，比起事务上的繁忙，更多的是心灵无...
say:4:1211016003:1.male: Yes, busy indeed. However, more than just being busy with work, it's hard for me not to worry about everything.
say:4:1211016003:1.female: Yes, busy indeed. However, more than just being busy with work, it's hard for me not to worry about everything.

say:5:1211016005:1.text: Nara, Sinbad, and your companions are all having a great time...
say:5:1211016005:1.source_cn: 奈拉和辛巴达，还有你的随从，玩得都很开心……
say:5:1211016005:1.male: Nara, Sinbad, and your companions are all having a great time...
say:5:1211016005:1.female: Nara, Sinbad, and your companions are all having a great time...

say:6:1211016006:1.text: Watching them have so much fun looking for this treasure, I found myself relaxing as well.
say:6:1211016006:1.source_cn: 看着他们享受这个寻宝游戏，我好像也慢慢放松下来了。
say:6:1211016006:1.male: Watching them have so much fun looking for this treasure, I found myself relaxing as well.
say:6:1211016006:1.female: Watching them have so much fun looking for this treasure, I found myself relaxing as well.

say:7:1211016007:1.text: I was skeptical at first. Nothing is free in this world...
say:7:1211016007:1.source_cn: 本来我对寻宝是持怀疑态度，世上哪有免费的馈赠？陷阱怎么...
say:7:1211016007:1.male: I was skeptical at first. Nothing is free in this world...
say:7:1211016007:1.female: I was skeptical at first. Nothing is free in this world...

say:8:1211016008:1.text: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...
say:8:1211016008:1.source_cn: 我习惯怀疑，我在这样的怀疑中度过了漫长的人生。就像……...
say:8:1211016008:1.male: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...
say:8:1211016008:1.female: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...

choice_prompt:9:1211016008.text: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...
choice_prompt:9:1211016008.source_cn: 我习惯怀疑，我在这样的怀疑中度过了漫长的人生。就像……奈拉一样。
choice_prompt:9:1211016008.male: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...
choice_prompt:9:1211016008.female: Well, I guess I'm just used to questioning everything. I've spent a long time unsure of life. Just like Nara...

say:10:1211016009:1.text: Yes, she's forgotten what happened and reverted to her old self. That's good... I hope she forgets.
say:10:1211016009:1.source_cn: 她忽然忘记了后来的那些事，一下子回到从前。也好……我希...
say:10:1211016009:1.male: Yes, she's forgotten what happened and reverted to her old self. That's good... I hope she forgets.
say:10:1211016009:1.female: Yes, she's forgotten what happened and reverted to her old self. That's good... I hope she forgets.

say:11:1211016010:1.text: ... I also seem to have forgotten a lot of things. Those stories that Nara told were from me. Can you believe it?
say:11:1211016010:1.source_cn: 但说到这些……我好像也已经忘记了很多事。奈拉刚才说的那...
say:11:1211016010:1.male: ... I also seem to have forgotten a lot of things. Those stories that Nara told were from me. Can you believe it?
say:11:1211016010:1.female: ... I also seem to have forgotten a lot of things. Those stories that Nara told were from me. Can you believe it?

say:12:1211016011:1.text: Thinking about it now, it feels like a dream back then...
say:12:1211016011:1.source_cn: 现在想想，那时的我们，好像梦一样……
say:12:1211016011:1.male: Thinking about it now, it feels like a dream back then...
say:12:1211016011:1.female: Thinking about it now, it feels like a dream back then...

say:13:1211016014:1.text: Thank you for listening, but I think I want to be alone for a bit.
say:13:1211016014:1.source_cn: 就这样吧，谢谢你，我想单独再休息一会儿。
say:13:1211016014:1.male: Thank you for listening, but I think I want to be alone for a bit.
say:13:1211016014:1.female: Thank you for listening, but I think I want to be alone for a bit.

say:14:1211016015:1.text: After all, it's hard to find a night like this...
say:14:1211016015:1.source_cn: 毕竟，这样的夜晚很难再有了。
say:14:1211016015:1.male: After all, it's hard to find a night like this...
say:14:1211016015:1.female: After all, it's hard to find a night like this...

say:16:1211016012:1.text: Yes, I had to take care of Nara by myself... I remember fighting the other urchins for food every day, but I always made sure to shield her from the cruelty of the outside world. That's why I told her those stories.
say:16:1211016012:1.source_cn: 照顾奈拉，和别的孩子抢吃的，给她编一个个美好故事，挡住...
say:16:1211016012:1.male: Yes, I had to take care of Nara by myself... I remember fighting the other urchins for food every day, but I always made sure to shield her from the cruelty of the outside world. That's why I told her those stories.
say:16:1211016012:1.female: Yes, I had to take care of Nara by myself... I remember fighting the other urchins for food every day, but I always made sure to shield her from the cruelty of the outside world. That's why I told her those stories.

say:17:1211016013:1.text: I've gotten used to being wary of everything. Even now, it's hard to change...
say:17:1211016013:1.source_cn: 我已经习惯了警惕一切，怀疑一切。到现在，也很难改变了……
say:17:1211016013:1.male: I've gotten used to being wary of everything. Even now, it's hard to change...
say:17:1211016013:1.female: I've gotten used to being wary of everything. Even now, it's hard to change...

choice:9:1:2.text: You must've been through a lot.
choice:9:1:2.male: You must've been through a lot.
choice:9:1:2.female: You must've been through a lot.

say:18:1211016004:1.source_cn: 是啊，放松……是时候放松一下了。

choice:3:1:2.text: Learn to relax once in a while.
choice:3:1:2.male: Learn to relax once in a while.
choice:3:1:2.female: Learn to relax once in a while.

say:2:1211017001:0.text: Doesn't this feel like a dream...?
say:2:1211017001:0.male: Doesn't this feel like a dream...?
say:2:1211017001:0.female: Doesn't this feel like a dream...?

say:3:1211017002:1.text: Going on an adventure with my friends, having a bonfire on the beach...
say:3:1211017002:1.source_cn: 像这样和伙伴们一起冒险，在沙滩上点燃篝火，舒服地休息…...
say:3:1211017002:1.male: Going on an adventure with my friends, having a bonfire on the beach...
say:3:1211017002:1.female: Going on an adventure with my friends, having a bonfire on the beach...

say:4:1211017003:1.text: I'm not thinking of tomorrow or the future... just living in the moment...
say:4:1211017003:1.source_cn: 不用去思考第二天的生计，也不用去思考将来的人生……
say:4:1211017003:1.male: I'm not thinking of tomorrow or the future... just living in the moment...
say:4:1211017003:1.female: I'm not thinking of tomorrow or the future... just living in the moment...

say:5:1211017004:1.text: We take the trial, and we succeed... and then we do it again.
say:5:1211017004:1.source_cn: 只需要接受试炼，在惊险刺激中取得胜利——然后再一次取得...
say:5:1211017004:1.male: We take the trial, and we succeed... and then we do it again.
say:5:1211017004:1.female: We take the trial, and we succeed... and then we do it again.

say:6:1211017005:1.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?
say:6:1211017005:1.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?
say:6:1211017005:1.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?

choice_prompt:7:1211017005.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?
choice_prompt:7:1211017005.source_cn: 喂，<style=stress><player_name></style>……你不觉得这简直太顺利了吗？
choice_prompt:7:1211017005.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?
choice_prompt:7:1211017005.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... don't you think this is going a little too smoothly?

say:8:1211017006:1.text: Of course! Since coming to these islands, I've been living the life I've always dreamed of.
say:8:1211017006:1.source_cn: 当然好，我激动得不行。自从来到这些岛屿，我终于过上了梦...
say:8:1211017006:1.male: Of course! Since coming to these islands, I've been living the life I've always dreamed of.
say:8:1211017006:1.female: Of course! Since coming to these islands, I've been living the life I've always dreamed of.

say:9:1211017009:1.text: But because everything has gone so smoothly, I'm just a little worried...
say:9:1211017009:1.source_cn: 但是，正因它是如此标准，如此顺利，我才开始害怕……
say:9:1211017009:1.male: But because everything has gone so smoothly, I'm just a little worried...
say:9:1211017009:1.female: But because everything has gone so smoothly, I'm just a little worried...

say:10:1211017010:1.text: Like I said, this is the adventure I've always wanted. Is this really happening?
say:10:1211017010:1.source_cn: 这样的试炼和冒险，是我想要的吗？我真的可以……就这样梦...
say:10:1211017010:1.male: Like I said, this is the adventure I've always wanted. Is this really happening?
say:10:1211017010:1.female: Like I said, this is the adventure I've always wanted. Is this really happening?

say:11:1211017011:1.text: Even this feeling of peace seems surreal...
say:11:1211017011:1.source_cn: 这么想着，好像连这份安宁都有些不真实了……
say:11:1211017011:1.male: Even this feeling of peace seems surreal...
say:11:1211017011:1.female: Even this feeling of peace seems surreal...

say:12:1211017012:1.text: Don't laugh at me, alright...? Just let me quietly enjoy this...
say:12:1211017012:1.source_cn: 别笑话我。当然我知道你也不会，但……让我静静地想一想吧……
say:12:1211017012:1.male: Don't laugh at me, alright...? Just let me quietly enjoy this...
say:12:1211017012:1.female: Don't laugh at me, alright...? Just let me quietly enjoy this...

say:14:1211017007:1.text: It's like those unbelievable tales spun by old sailors... Will our adventures end up in songs and legends?
say:14:1211017007:1.source_cn: 是啊，就像那些传奇的冒险故事，我们是不是也在书写属于我...
say:14:1211017007:1.male: It's like those unbelievable tales spun by old sailors... Will our adventures end up in songs and legends?
say:14:1211017007:1.female: It's like those unbelievable tales spun by old sailors... Will our adventures end up in songs and legends?

say:15:1211017008:1.text: I bet the first day we met was the start of our story together.
say:15:1211017008:1.source_cn: 我敢打赌，遇到你的第一天，一定就是故事的序章！
say:15:1211017008:1.male: I bet the first day we met was the start of our story together.

say:5:1211018005:1.text: Can you tell me why Sinbad is scared of me?

say:5:1211018005:1.female: Can you tell me why Sinbad is scared of me?

say:6:1211018006:1.text: Although he's taking us treasure hunting, he's keeping his distance from me. It feels like he's afraid that I'll suddenly stab him in the back or something.
say:6:1211018006:1.source_cn: 虽然他带我寻宝，但是他总是与我保持距离，好像怕我突然从...

say:10:1211018009:1.text: Also, why do I have so many wounds and scars on my body?
say:10:1211018009:1.source_cn: 我也很想知道，为什么一觉醒来，我身上多了这么多伤口？

say:10:1211018009:1.female: Also, why do I have so many wounds and scars on my body?

say:12:1211018013:1.female: Let me tell you a little secret.

say:15:1211018015:1.male: Oh, you're no fun. I told you a secret, but you just tossed it aside.
say:15:1211018015:1.female: Oh, you're no fun. I told you a secret, but you just tossed it aside.

narration:1:1211019001:0.text: Amidst the sound of waves, everyone falls asleep with their own thoughts...
narration:1:1211019001:0.source_cn: 在阵阵海浪声中，大家各怀心事，进入了梦乡……

say:0:1211020001:0.text: Wake up, everyone! Chippy found it!

say:1:1211021001:1.text: Last night, Chippy had a dream!

say:2:1211021002:1.text: In the dream, Chippy burrowed into the sand and kept going forward, following a voice. When Chippy came out, Chippy saw something strange.
say:2:1211021002:1.source_cn: 梦中我钻进沙子里，追着一个声音一直往前走，钻出来后，我...

choice_prompt:3:1211021002.text: In the dream, Chippy burrowed into the sand and kept going forward, following a voice. When Chippy came out, Chippy saw something strange.
choice_prompt:3:1211021002.source_cn: 梦中我钻进沙子里，追着一个声音一直往前走，钻出来后，我看到了一个奇怪的东西。

say:4:1211021003:1.text: Chippy didn't hear it clearly, but it seemed to be a woman.
say:4:1211021003:1.source_cn: 满满没有听清，好像是个女性。
say:4:1211021003:1.male: Chippy didn't hear it clearly, but it seemed to be a woman.
say:4:1211021003:1.female: Chippy didn't hear it clearly, but it seemed to be a woman.

say:5:1211021005:0.text: The voice told Chippy to place a fish on the disk and pray, and then we could awaken the daughter of the ocean, the princess.
say:5:1211021005:0.source_cn: 那个人告诉我，把鱼放在圆盘上，向其祈祷，就能唤醒海洋的...

say:6:1211021006:1.text: Chippy thought the dream was too incredible to be real. After waking up, Chippy went to check it out in case it was a trap.
say:6:1211021006:1.source_cn: 满满也觉得不可思议……\n醒来后，满满担心是陷阱，就去...

say:7:1211021007:1.text: The disk is actually there, Magister! Chippy's dream was true!
say:7:1211021007:1.source_cn: 没想到圆盘真的在那里！主人，这一定是所谓的梦想成真吧！
say:7:1211021007:1.male: The disk is actually there, Magister! Chippy's dream was true!
say:7:1211021007:1.female: The disk is actually there, Magister! Chippy's dream was true!

say:9:1211021008:1.text: Wow, dreams really do come true on this island...
say:9:1211021008:1.source_cn: 哇哦，在这座岛上，还真能梦想成真？

say:10:1211021009:1.text: Let's go take a look. If we don't quickly deal with the fish we caught yesterday, they're just gonna to end as breakfast.
say:10:1211021009:1.source_cn: 总之先去看看吧，再不赶紧把昨天抓的这些鱼处理了，它们就...

say:0:1211022001:0.text: Who was the person talking in Chippy's dream?
say:0:1211022001:0.source_cn: 在梦里和我说话的人，到底是谁呢？

say:1:1211022002:0.source_cn: 说不定是塔西在指引我们。

say:1:1211024001:1.text: I can't believe the key was hidden in the mouth of the damedangler! Ugh! There's so much saliva!
say:1:1211024001:1.source_cn: 这把钥匙居然藏在冥湾美人的嘴里！呃，好多口水！

say:3:1211024002:1.text: So the damedangler was the princess of the ocean... We were fooled again.
say:3:1211024002:1.source_cn: 这个冥湾美人居然就是海洋的公主……我们又一次上了它的当。

say:6:1211024004:1.text: But what does this have to do with cycles...?
say:6:1211024004:1.source_cn: 但是……这到底和循环有什么关系啊！

choice_prompt:7:1211024004.text: But what does this have to do with cycles...?
choice_prompt:7:1211024004.source_cn: 但是……这到底和循环有什么关系啊！

say:9:1211024006:0.text: So we spent all this time and effort catching three types of fish just because this "princess" had a craving?
say:9:1211024006:0.source_cn: 结果花费心思收集三种鱼，只因为这位“公主”喜欢吃不同口味？

say:11:1211024007:0.text: Ha! Even Sonja is making jokes now.
say:11:1211024007:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，连索尼娅姐姐都会开玩笑了！

say:13:1211024005:0.text: Perhaps in this part of the ocean, the damedangler can indeed be regarded as a beautiful princess...
say:13:1211024005:0.source_cn: 或许在这片海域里，那条冥湾美人确实算得上是公主殿下吧……
